title: KAITO — Pick A Side!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience.
We're looking forward to seeing you perform today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
We're also looking forward to playing!

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Haha. You certainly sound excited.
Again, I apologize for making you do this today.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: But I've genuinely been looking forward to your performance, so I'm hoping for something outstanding.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Rin, they'll see you if you poke your head out too far...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I wanna see if they're really gonna be okay! They seemed kinda nervous just now!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I know. But I think that's a good thing since it means they're alert.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And they practiced all they could just for today, so I'm sure they'll leave a good impression.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They do know how to deliver when it really counts.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, that's something they're really good at.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<...!
They're starting...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hnnnng!!!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Huh? Rin...?
What are you doing...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're not supposed to interrupt them by cheering, right?! So, I'm trying to tell them telepathically!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then, I'll join you.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(They're doing well...
Honami's also doing a good job of leading them through the part they were having trouble with during practice.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They sound confident.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, they're putting on a wonderful performance.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <They are...>
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They played super duper well♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
They did.
I was on the edge of my seat the entire time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too.
It sort of felt like an actual show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It did. Their performance really hit you in the face with how they feel.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They must've been able to take all the frustration they'd been feeling lately and turn it into the fuel that powered this performance.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Also, where are they?
I wanna tell them how amazing their performance was!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They may be speaking with the president right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Probably. I'm sure they'll come right over when they're done.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I might forget all the things I wanna tell them! What do I do then?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Geez. Alright, how about writing your thoughts down on the blackboard?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, good idea!
I won't miss anything as long as I write it all down♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I'll join you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I will as well since it might help them when they do their debrief.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's make things easy for them by keeping comments on the same parts together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, let's split this board into the first and second verses! And we can write about the chorus and bridge on... Oh, the one in the back!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I think I'll start with the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I will as well.
It'll be easier to write if we're not all at the same blackboard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hmm... What should we do?
There's a lot I want to write about, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why don't we wait for a little bit to see what the others write...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, hang on...
I think they're here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! But I haven't finished writing everything down!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For now, I'll go greet them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll join you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll try to buy some time for the rest of you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're the best, MEIKO!
You too, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure how much I'll be able to help...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's go find them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, we need to be careful not to say anything about their performance before the others finish writing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True... But I don't think we have to worry too much, considering how much they've been writing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I suppose so. Anyway, let's go.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay...
